briefing.summary: Descending into Canberra, in radar contact with Approach. They've just cleared you for the ILS.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, cleared ILS runway three five approach, report established.

challenge.expectedText: Cleared ILS runway three five approach, report established, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.label: Reporting instruction
elements.hint: Any reporting instruction must be read back per MATS Part 4.

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: approach clearance readback includes approach type, runway, any reporting instructions, and callsign. ATIS/QNH only when newly issued in the clearance.
